title: With j universally closed the etale neighbourhood conclusion can be shrunk so that R' is exactly the restriction of the base changed groupoid

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Apply lemma-quasi-finite-over-base to the groupoid (U, R, s, t, c) over S with points p and u, obtaining an etale neighbourhood (S', p') to (S, p), disjoint union decompositions S' times_S U = U' coprod W and S' times_S R = R' coprod W', and u' in U' satisfying conclusions (a) through (g). The neighbourhood may be shrunk without affecting (a) through (g). Let j' be the base change of j to S'. By conclusion (e) the inverse image j'^{-1}(U' times_{S'} U') decomposes as R' coprod Rest with Rest open and closed. Since U' to S' is finite by conclusion (d), U' times_{S'} U' is finite over S'; since j is universally closed, so is j', and hence j' restricted to Rest is universally closed. Conclusions (b) and (c) show the fibre of (U' times_{S'} U' to S') composed with j'|_Rest over p' is empty; as Rest to S' is closed, replacing S' by S' minus the image of Rest to S' makes Rest empty, which is exactly the condition that R' is the restriction of S' times_S R to U', by the restrict-groupoid-relation lemma and its proof. (source lines 2585-2622)

standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies Rest = empty set with the condition that R' is the restriction of S' times_S R to the open U', giving conclusion (h).

core_obligations: Apply lemma-quasi-finite-over-base for (U, R, s, t, c) over S with points p and u: get the etale neighbourhood (S', p') to (S, p), the decompositions S' times_S U = U' coprod W and S' times_S R = R' coprod W', and u' in U' satisfying (a), (b), (c), (d), (e), (f), (g) (proof lines 2586-2594). Note S' may be shrunk to a smaller neighbourhood of p' without affecting (a) through (g); the goal is a shrinking with (h) (proof lines 2595-2597). Put j' = base change of j to S'; by conclusion (e), j'^{-1}(U' times_{S'} U') = R' coprod Rest for some open and closed Rest (proof lines 2598-2603). By (d), U' to S' is finite, so U' times_{S'} U' is finite over S'; universal closedness of j passes to j' and to j'|_Rest (proof lines 2603-2606). By (b) and (c) the fibre of (U' times_{S'} U' to S') composed with j'|_Rest over p' is empty; since Rest to S' is a composition of closed morphisms, replacing S' by S' minus the image of Rest to S' allows assuming Rest = empty set, which by groupoids-lemma-restrict-groupoid-relation and its proof is exactly the condition that R' is the restriction of S' times_S R to U' (proof lines 2606-2621).
proof_roadmap: Apply the base lemma and record the decomposition with conclusions (a) through (g), noting shrinkability of S' (proof lines 2586-2597).
Split j'^{-1}(U' times_{S'} U') = R' coprod Rest with Rest open and closed using conclusion (e) (proof lines 2598-2603).
Show Rest maps to a closed subset of S' disjoint from p' using finiteness from (d), universal closedness of j, and the fibre emptiness from (b) and (c) (proof lines 2603-2614).
Shrink S' to remove the image of Rest, making Rest empty, and identify this with condition (h) via the restrict-groupoid-relation criterion (proof lines 2614-2621).
